leaves.name: sga7_IX_3_5_ForwardGeom
leaves.doc: gt-unip, printed form, strictly henselian base: SGA 7 I Exp. IX Prop. 3.5, direction semistable => (sigma-1)^2 = 0 on T_l = lim A(K^s)[l^n] for sigma in inertia, one sigma at a time (the print gives (sigma-1)(tau-1) = 0 and the converse); number UNVERIFIED. Semistability read on the geometric special fibre; reading risk: if the print reads it over k(s), this form exceeds the print by UnipotentForward.SemiAbelianDescendsSepClosed for imperfect residue fields only (the reading-robust variant is UnipotentForward.semistableUnipotent_of_forward). Replaces semistableUnipotent; StrictHenselizationInside and the K^s axis are proved.
